hook: Why are tankers burning at Hormuz?
reel_hook: Tankers on fire in a closed strait

slides.title: Tankers ablaze near Hormuz
slides.image_prompt: Oil tanker burning at sea at dawn, black smoke rising over calm water, rocky coastline in the distance
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran says at least three tankers hit mines near Hormuz.
WHY IT MATTERS
Iran keeps the strait shut until US meets 7 conditions.
FOR YOU
Oil prices edged up; Iran's mine claim hasn't been independently verified.
slides.body: Iran says at least three tankers hit mines near Hormuz. Iran keeps the strait shut until US meets 7 conditions. Oil prices edged up; Iran's mine claim hasn't been independently verified.

slides.title: US envoys land in Moscow
slides.image_prompt: Two empty chairs facing each other across a long polished table in an ornate hall, snowy Kremlin towers through the window
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Witkoff and Kushner landed in Moscow to meet Putin.
WHY IT MATTERS
It follows two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi.
FOR YOU
What Putin tells them could shape the next peace steps; talks were ongoing.
slides.body: Witkoff and Kushner landed in Moscow to meet Putin. It follows two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi. What Putin tells them could shape the next peace steps; talks were ongoing.

slides.title: Land still blocks peace
slides.image_prompt: Torn paper map split into two pieces on a wooden table, a pen resting between them, soft window light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Abu Dhabi talks ended without a major breakthrough.
WHY IT MATTERS
US mediators say the sides still disagree on territory.
FOR YOU
Both sides talk of momentum toward peace, but there is no deal yet.
slides.body: Abu Dhabi talks ended without a major breakthrough. US mediators say the sides still disagree on territory. Both sides talk of momentum toward peace, but there is no deal yet.
slides.credit: Clint Ian Pinto (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

slides.title: Europe at the table? Russia: no
slides.image_prompt: An empty chair pulled slightly away from a round negotiating table, a small blue flag with gold stars lying folded on the seat
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Ukraine and the US want Europe in the peace talks.
WHY IT MATTERS
Russia opposes it, adding another open dispute.
FOR YOU
Whether Europe joins decides who gets a say in ending the war.
slides.body: Ukraine and the US want Europe in the peace talks. Russia opposes it, adding another open dispute. Whether Europe joins decides who gets a say in ending the war.
slides.credit: Håkan Dahlström from Malmö, Sweden (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

slides.title: A big prisoner swap is agreed
slides.image_prompt: An open iron gate on a quiet country road at sunrise, two empty benches facing each other on either side, warm golden light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Russia and Ukraine agreed a large prisoner-of-war exchange.
WHY IT MATTERS
Russia says over 1,000 each side; past swaps were smaller.
FOR YOU
Final numbers aren't confirmed yet; Kushner says it will reunite families.
slides.body: Russia and Ukraine agreed a large prisoner-of-war exchange. Russia says over 1,000 each side; past swaps were smaller. Final numbers aren't confirmed yet; Kushner says it will reunite families.

caption:
🔥 Iran says at least three tankers hit mines near Hormuz; oil prices edged up, but the mine claim isn't independently verified.
🚧 Iran says the strait stays shut until the US meets 7 conditions.
✈️ US envoys Witkoff and Kushner landed in Moscow to meet Putin.
🗺️ Abu Dhabi talks ended with no breakthrough: territory is still the sticking point.
🇪🇺 Ukraine and the US want Europe in the talks; Russia says no.
🤝 Good news: a large prisoner swap is agreed, possibly over 1,000 on each side, according to Russia.

Should Europe have a seat at the table? Tell us below 👇
